title: Comparison_of_Gaussian_process_software
summary: A comparison of statistical software for Gaussian process inference, often using approximations. Written from the point of view of Bayesian statistics. The article covers hyperparameter estimation (specifying arbitrary hyperpriors, estimating posteriors beyond point estimation), linear transformations, scalability and approximations (sparse algorithms based on inducing points, hierarchical algorithms approximating covariance matrices), and input space support (multidimensional input, arbitrary non-real input). Related academic work by Erickson, Ankenman, and Sanchez shows that very different results can be obtained from different packages even when using the same data and model, revealing stark differences between packages across four platforms.
